_published_faq.name: How do I add lemlist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add lemlist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.lemlist.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the lemlist MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: lemlist provides these MCP tools: create_campaign_with_sequence, get_campaign_details, get_campaign_sequences, get_inbox_conversations, get_lemleads_filters, get_settings, lemleads_search, load_skill, push_leads_to_contacts, and search_help_center.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to lemlist?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to lemlist in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
lemlist requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
lemlist is developed by lemlist. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
